# unifi_official_devices (Data Source)

Lists the devices adopted on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the devices adopted on the site via the Official API.
# Named distinctly from the internal unifi_device data source.
data "unifi_official_devices" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing adopted devices.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The adopted devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `features` (List of String) The device feature roles (e.g. `switching`, `accessPoint`, `gateway`).
- `firmware_updatable` (Boolean) Whether a firmware update is available for the device.
- `firmware_version` (String) The device firmware version, if known.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the adopted device.
- `ip_address` (String) The device IP address.
- `json` (String) The full device overview, including nested interfaces, serialized as a JSON string.
- `mac_address` (String) The device MAC address.
- `model` (String) The device model.
- `name` (String) The device name.
- `state` (String) The device state (e.g. `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `UPDATING`).
- `supported` (Boolean) Whether the device is supported by the controller.
